summary.text: Ed Fellows is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 58B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Drew Roach (R).
His career has been in education administration.

paragraphs.text: Ed Fellows graduated from Farmington High School and earned a bachelor's degree from St. Cloud State University and a graduate degree from Texas A&M University.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has spent 30 years as a teacher, coach and leader, and that he is a husband and the father of three daughters and a son.
He said his campaign priorities include affordability, with lower everyday costs and property tax relief, as well as affordable health care and a district attractive to businesses.
